title: FeatLock Core Anti-Deletion, Replayable State & Plugin Boundary Laws

laws.invariant: SQLite BEFORE DELETE triggers abort direct deletion of active features, active feature_tests, and active invariants (modeled in .verification/formal/featlock_guards.qnt).
Transitioning an active feature to status='removed' fails closed unless adr_ref, removal_reason, and ALLOW_FEATURE_REMOVAL=1 are all present.
Guarded plugins (featlock.guard.anti-deletion) cannot be disabled by plugin remove selectors or wildcards, and crashing sibling plugins are fault-isolated.
Serializing any valid RegistrySnapshot to SQL and loading it back into SQLite preserves all features, tests, invariants, and audit entries deterministically.
